analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

· Below SMA100($10.36), below SMA200($13.01): mid-to-long-term trend weakness

[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($9.66): based on Pivot Point (PP)
· Swing resistance ($10.14): potential for short-term bounce on breakout
· 5-day high < 20-day high pattern (Lower High): weakening signal confirmed
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): conditions met for waiting
